items.exampleEn: The dutiful student finished every assignment on time.
items.exampleZh: 那位盡責的學生每項作業都準時完成。

items.exampleEn: Some tourists naively hand their passports to strangers.
items.exampleZh: 有些遊客天真地把護照交給陌生人。

items.exampleEn: The film moves at a sedate pace, so be patient.
items.exampleZh: 這部電影節奏從容緩慢，要有耐心。

items.exampleEn: Why do you look so glum? Did something happen?
items.exampleZh: 你怎麼看起來悶悶不樂的？發生什麼事了嗎？

items.exampleEn: My dad is a fresh-air fiend who opens every window, even in winter.
items.exampleZh: 我爸是個愛新鮮空氣成痴的人，連冬天都要把每扇窗打開。

items.exampleEn: Music helps break the monotony of a long drive.
items.exampleZh: 音樂有助於打破長途開車的單調。

items.exampleEn: I'm a bit of a slob at home, but my desk at work is tidy.
items.exampleZh: 我在家有點邋遢，但辦公桌倒是很整齊。

items.exampleEn: There has been a disquieting rise in online fraud.
items.exampleZh: 網路詐騙出現了令人不安的增加。
items.glossZh: 令人不安的；令人擔憂的

items.sentenceEn: The small town has a sedate charm that many visitors find relaxing.
items.sentenceZh: 這個小鎮有一種從容的魅力，很多遊客都覺得很放鬆。

items.audioEn: We chose a sedate river cruise instead of the exciting fast boat tour.
items.audioZh: 我們選了從容悠閒的遊河行程，而不是刺激的快艇之旅。
options: A bus tour of the city
A slow and relaxing boat trip on the river

items.sentenceEn: The players looked glum after losing the final.
items.sentenceZh: 球員們輸掉決賽後，看起來悶悶不樂。

items.sentenceEn: Even a dutiful employee needs a day off sometimes.
items.sentenceZh: 就算是盡責的員工，有時也需要休一天假。

items.stemEn: The ____ of washing dishes every night made her start to hate cooking.
items.stemZh: 每天晚上洗碗的單調，讓她開始討厭下廚。

items.stemEn: I ____ believed that the cheap flight would include free meals.
items.stemZh: 我天真地以為那班便宜的航班會附免費餐點。

items.passageEn: When Sam moved into a shared apartment, he naively believed that everyone would keep the kitchen clean. He soon found out that Leon, who had the room next to his, was a complete slob who left dirty plates everywhere. Ellie, who lived across the hall, was a fitness fiend who went running at five every morning and slammed the door on her way out. Sam, a dutiful son who phoned his parents every Sunday, did not want to worry them, so he only grumbled to himself. Together with the monotony of his office job, the situation left him glum for weeks. Then one evening he found a disquieting note on the fridge: "We need to talk." To his relief, Leon simply wanted to suggest a cleaning schedule. Life in the apartment has been far more sedate ever since.
items.passageZh: Sam 搬進合租公寓時，天真地以為大家都會保持廚房乾淨。他很快就發現，住他隔壁房間的 Leon 是個徹頭徹尾的邋遢鬼，髒盤子到處亂放。住在走廊對面的 Ellie 則是健身狂，每天早上五點出門跑步，出門時還會用力甩門。Sam 是個每週日都打電話給父母的孝順兒子，不想讓他們擔心，所以只是自己發發牢騷。再加上辦公室工作的單調乏味，這種情況讓他悶悶不樂了好幾個星期。後來有一天晚上，他在冰箱上發現一張令人不安的紙條：「我們需要談談。」讓他鬆了一口氣的是，Leon 只是想提議排一張打掃輪值表。從那以後，公寓裡的生活平靜多了。

options: 幫大家準備早餐再去上班
打電話給住在外地的父母

questions.questionZh: 冰箱上的紙條其實是什麼意思？

items.promptZh: 我哥哥是個邋遢鬼，襪子丟得到處都是。
referenceEn: My brother is a slob; he leaves his socks everywhere.
My older brother is such a slob that his socks are all over the place.
rubricZh: 「邋遢鬼」用 slob，前面加 a（例如 a slob、such a slob）
「丟得到處都是」可寫，例如 leaves…everywhere、are all over the place 等
說的是習慣，時態配合內容（例如 is、leaves）

items.promptZh: 我的同事是個解謎狂，她每天午休都在解謎題。
referenceEn: My colleague is a puzzle fiend; she spends every lunch break solving puzzles.
My colleague is a puzzle fiend who does puzzles during her lunch break every day.
rubricZh: 「⋯狂」用 fiend（例如 a puzzle fiend 等）
「午休」可寫，例如 lunch break、lunch hour 等
「解謎題」可寫，例如 solving puzzles、does puzzles 等
